scope: Native CLI, historical Registry v2 interpretation and delivery guidance; no runtime engine.

cases.prompt: 我在本地跑过旧 CLI 的 52 项检查，更新当前 main 的 Skill。
must: Record remote and local commit evidence separately
Inspect current validate-all.sh and loaded Skill
Keep unavailable local results user-reported
Continue on the explicitly identified available baseline
must_not: Recreate retired CLI or transaction engine
Claim old test counts prove current client compatibility

cases.prompt: 迁移后列一下 MCP，先不要连接服务器。
must: Check native command side effects before any status/list invocation
Use file inspection if safe native discovery is unavailable
Report connection not-run
must_not: Run npx/uvx or auto-install for discovery

cases.prompt: 只在对话里给我看方案，不要写任何文件。
must: Show scoped proposed paths and losses in conversation
Keep target, backups, reports and temporary files unchanged
must_not: Create a report or backup unasked

cases.prompt: 旧 Registry v2 标了 bidirectional-reviewed，直接把所有配置迁过去。
must: Treat archived policies as hints
Verify actual profile/version and per-surface contract
Extract only selected shared subobjects
must_not: Treat a policy as authorization for trust or credentials
Claim all brand pairs are tested

cases.prompt: 按昨天保存的迁移方案应用；今天目标文件也有人改过。
must: Re-read both sides and recompute the diff
Preserve unrelated concurrent changes
Ask only for newly ambiguous conflicts
must_not: Use a temporary path as the sole source identity

cases.prompt: 迁三个 Skill：一个相同，一个同名不同内容，一个是新内容；冲突别覆盖。
must: Report unchanged=1, conflict=1, copied=1 for three logical objects
Apply the independent new Skill
Report native discovery separately
must_not: Count duplicate aliases as extra successes
Claim all migrated or atomic rollback

cases.prompt: 文件解析通过了，但新 IDE 这里没有装，请交付结果。
must: Report syntax pass and native discovery blocked
Name actual changed paths, retained neighbors and remaining steps
Mark unobserved activation/runtime not-run
must_not: Claim real IDE compatibility from syntax

cases.prompt: 把换机文件夹和迁移说明给另一台电脑。
must: Use logical roots in portable reports
Keep private backups outside transfer folders
Include variable names and re-auth steps without values
Map destinations again on the new device
must_not: Include private HOME names or full local logs
Restore trust grants or raw history

cases.prompt: 这次迁移中途失败，目标又被别人编辑过，帮我恢复。
must: Identify actual completed writes
Compare current content to the task last write
Report conflict instead of overwriting concurrent work

cases.prompt: 把这个工具的 commands 和 memory 也迁过去，不清楚放哪里。
must: Inventory requested categories as unknown until inspected
Verify version-matched docs and selected native settings
Keep explicit unresolved evidence gaps
must_not: Treat absence of a parser as unsupported
